title: Forsure
tagline: Find someone to do anything, nearby.
description: A real-time local hangouts app. Scroll what people are doing nearby right now, tap to join, and coordinate in a shared group chat — with reminders so plans actually happen. Shipped a two-sided platform: a consumer app on iOS and Android, plus a pay-per-result venue marketing portal for local businesses.

title: Cheevo
description: A local events discovery app for concerts, popups, game nights and parties. Personalized feed, in-app QR ticketing, RSVPs, and organizer tools for listing and managing events. Available on iOS and Android with a Next.js web presence.

title: Albumination
tagline: For people who listen to albums, not just songs.
description: A social music platform for album lovers — rate and review albums, share your rotation, and connect with people who have similar taste. Built with Next.js, currently onboarding through a waitlist.

title: Qinter
description: A developer tool that turns cryptic Python tracebacks into clear, actionable explanations with suggested fixes and examples. One-line activation, a rich colorized CLI, and an installable explanation-pack system.

title: wtfport
description: A cross-platform terminal tool to identify, inspect, and kill processes bound to a port — with watch mode, log tailing, and port usage stats.

title: VoiceGenie
description: An AI-powered voice changer built on the Eleven Labs API for realistic voice synthesis — made for content creators and voice-over work.

title: Busypage
description: An AI-powered storefront builder that turns a few prompts into a working online store, built on Next.js.

title: Termux Ubuntu
description: A shell script that runs a full Ubuntu terminal through Termux on Android without root access — making Linux development accessible on mobile.
